page_title: ລະບົບ ແລະ ການຊ່ວຍເຫຼືອ
page_lead: ສາມາດກວດເບິ່ງລະບົບທີ່ກ່ຽວກັບການຖືພາ ການຄອດ ແລະ ການລ້ຽງລູກຕາມໄລຍະໄດ້.
intro_title: ລະບົບຫຼັກສຳລັບການຖືພາ ການຄອດ ແລະ ການລ້ຽງລູກ
intro_copy: ຄົ້ນຫາລະບົບຫຼັກຕາມໄລຍະ ແລະ ບ່ອນຍື່ນຄຳຮ້ອງ. ເປີດກາດເພື່ອເບິ່ງຜູ້ມີສິດ, ສະຫຼຸບ ແລະ ພື້ນຖານກົດໝາຍ.
source_note: ແຫຼ່ງອ້າງອີງ: ລາຍຊື່ລະບົບຫຼັກສຳລັບການຖືພາ ການຄອດ ແລະ ການລ້ຽງລູກ (14 ເມສາ 2026)

maternal_child_handbook.title: Issuance of the Maternal and Child Health Handbook
maternal_child_handbook.overview: Issued when pregnancy is reported. Used to record checkups and vaccinations, and to support pregnancy, childbirth, and child-rearing.
maternal_child_handbook.basis: Maternal and Child Health Act, Article 16

prenatal_checkup_subsidy.title: Public Subsidy for Prenatal Checkups
prenatal_checkup_subsidy.overview: Local governments cover part of the cost of prenatal checkups.
prenatal_checkup_subsidy.basis: Maternal and Child Health Act, Article 13

maternal_health_leave.title: Leave for Pregnant Women / Maternal Health Management Measures
maternal_health_leave.overview: Leave for medical visits and rest based on a doctor's instructions. Workers may request staggered hours, shorter hours, and rest periods.
maternal_health_leave.basis: Equal Employment Opportunity Act, Articles 12 and 13

maternity_leave.title: Prenatal and Postnatal Leave
maternity_leave.overview: Leave from 6 weeks before childbirth (14 weeks for multiple pregnancy) to 8 weeks after childbirth.

childbirth_lump_sum.title: Lump-Sum Childbirth and Childcare Allowance
childbirth_lump_sum.overview: In principle, 500,000 yen is paid to cover childbirth costs from April 2023.

maternity_allowance.title: Maternity Allowance
maternity_allowance.overview: Income support during leave before and after childbirth. If no salary is paid during maternity leave, about two-thirds of the daily wage is provided.

postpartum_care.title: Postpartum Care Services
postpartum_care.overview: Support for mothers and babies through overnight stays, day visits, and home visits.
postpartum_care.basis: Maternal and Child Health Act, Article 17-2

newborn_home_visit.title: Newborn Home Visit Guidance
newborn_home_visit.overview: Home visits by public health nurses and other professionals.
newborn_home_visit.basis: Maternal and Child Health Act, Article 11

postnatal_paternity_leave.title: Postnatal Paternity Leave
postnatal_paternity_leave.overview: Can be taken within 8 weeks after birth for up to 4 weeks, and may be split into two periods.

childcare_leave.title: Childcare Leave
childcare_leave.overview: In principle, available until the child turns 1 year old, and in some cases up to 2 years old.
childcare_leave.basis: Child Care and Family Care Leave Act, Article 5

childcare_leave_benefit.title: Childcare Leave Benefit
childcare_leave_benefit.overview: Paid from employment insurance to support living expenses during childcare leave and compensate for lost income. The benefit rate is about 67%, then 50%.

social_insurance_exemption.title: Exemption from Social Insurance Premiums
social_insurance_exemption.target: People taking maternity or childcare leave
social_insurance_exemption.overview: Health insurance and pension insurance premiums are exempt during the leave period.
social_insurance_exemption.basis: Health Insurance Act Articles 159 and 160, Employees’ Pension Insurance Act Article 81-2

child_allowance.title: Child Allowance
child_allowance.overview: Paid to households raising children through completion of junior high school.

infant_medical_subsidy.title: Medical Expense Subsidy for Infants and Young Children

nursery_certified_center.title: Nursery Schools and Certified Childcare Centers

child_nursing_leave.title: Child Nursing Leave
child_nursing_leave.target: Working parents raising children up to the third grade of elementary school
child_nursing_leave.overview: Up to 5 days per year, or 10 days for two or more children, for a child's illness or vaccination.
child_nursing_leave.basis: Child Care and Family Care Leave Act, Article 16-2
